purpose: Bounds the dependencies, parent, and build plugins that generated build configuration may declare. Enforced against the scaffolded POM before it is persisted (FR-017). Every entry must be resolvable from a pre-populated local Maven repository, because the hermetic offline build runs with network access disabled (Constitution IV).
deliberately_outside_instructions_dir: This file lives in backend/app/resources/, NOT inside backend/app/resources/instructions/. It is a generation constraint, not an instruction document, and is excluded from the instruction-set revision digest so that editing the allowlist does not change the revision recorded against generated artifacts. See specs/011-llm-generation-nodes/contracts/instruction-document.md.
seeded_from: The dependency set of the Quarkus 3.x and Java 21 LTS runtime baseline.

dependencies.why: Quarkus REST / RESTEasy Reactive core HTTP framework.
Quarkus REST with Jackson JSON serialization.
Panache Repository and EntityManager for domain entities.
Jakarta Validation integration for declarative constraints.
In-memory H2 database driver for hermetic testing.
PostgreSQL database driver for production deployment.
HTTP test client for Quarkus endpoint tests.
Fluent assertion library for JUnit test suites.

build_plugins.why: Builds fast-jar and manages Quarkus build-time augmentation.
Pins the Java 21 release level deterministically.

prohibited: Any groupId/artifactId pair not present in the dependencies list above.
Any build plugin not present in the build_plugins list above.
Version ranges, SNAPSHOT versions, and the LATEST or RELEASE selectors.
Any additional <repositories>, <pluginRepositories>, or remote repository declaration.
Any dependency with a javax.* groupId or artifactId.
Any build extension, remote script execution, or artifact downloaded at build time.
Any dependency, plugin, or property carrying a credential or access token.

enforcement.on_violation: Reject candidate artifact set if POM contains unlisted dependencies or plugins.
